limits: Small channel cases measured three times; circle once, on the same host. Timings include normal OS scheduling variability.
Channel initialized with analytic parabolic velocity; timings do not transfer to arbitrary flows.
No change to the discretization, linear or SIMPLE tolerances, 3000-step linear limit or mesh quality gates. IC0 has no shifting or hidden fallback.
No OpenFOAM run or desktop repackaging in these measurements.

Large channel cases are single timing samples with different local refinement box widths; they demonstrate scale and analytic errors, not a controlled grid-independence study or complex external-flow performance.

Legacy six-file hash comparison changes the summary JSON because pressurePreconditioner metadata was added; IC0 also changes physical last digits, quantified in fieldDifferenceToOriginal rather than claimed byte-identical.
